Units in Cult Ambush
Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker as described below, or by following the rules for Strategic Reserves in a subsequent turn. Units in Cult Ambush are not automically destroyed at the end of the third battle round.

Cult Ambush Markers
Use a circular 32mm diameter marker for Cult Ambush markers. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 8" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of your opponent’s next Movement phase, for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, you can select one unit from your army that is in Cult Ambush to make an ingress move. For that ingress move, set that unit up with at least one model in that unit in base contact with that Cult Ambush marker and all other models placed wholly within 3" of that Cult Ambush marker (that Cult Ambush marker is then removed from the battlefield). Units in Cult Ambush can make an ingress move in the first battle round using this rule.

Units in Cult Ambush
Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Cult Ambush Markers

stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit that is visible to both of those selected units and within range of at least one ranged weapon from each of those units. Until the end of the phase, models in those units can only make attacks that target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). When doing so, each time such a model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.t: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves.
stratagems.tg: One Astra Militarum or GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.t: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.tg: One Astra Militarum Vehicle unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers. You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units and wholly within 6" of your unit.

stratagems.t: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Astra Militarum unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.tg: That ASTRA MILITARUM unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot be targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem and each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army selects that enemy unit as a target of a charge, you can re-roll the Charge roll.

stratagems.t: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Astra Militarum unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after it has resolved those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those GENESTEALER CULTS units: on a 5+, the unit being rolled for suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

stratagems.t: Brood Brother Auxilia – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Astra Militarum Infantry Regiment unit from your army (excluding Artillery and Character units) is destroyed.
stratagems.tg: That INFANTRY unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.fx: Roll one D6: on a 3+, place one Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed) and add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
stratagems.rs: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Genestealer Cults unit within 12" of a friendly engaged Tyranids unit declares a charge.
stratagems.tg: That GENESTEALER CULTS unit.
stratagems.fx:
• Your unit has +1 to charge rolls.
• You can use this part of this **stratagem**. If you do:
• Your unit can re-roll **charge rolls**.
• Your unit must end that charge move **engaged** with an enemy unit **engaged** with that friendly TYRANIDS unit.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.tg: One Tyranids Character unit from your army that was destroyed by that enemy unit this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the battle, each time a Genestealer Cults model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Genestealer Cults unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If one or more friendly Tyranids units are within 6" of that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.tg: One Tyranids unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the start of your next Command phase, increase the range of your unit’s Catalyst ability by 3".
stratagems.rs: Each time you use this Stratagem, until the end of your next Command phase, you cannot use this Stratagem again.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One Tyranids unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Genestealer Cults or Tyranids unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit has attacked, if those attacks destroyed an enemy unit or an enemy CHARACTER model.
stratagems.tg: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.fx: Each visible friendly battle-shocked GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly KILLER unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.tg: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.fx: Attacks made by KILLER models in your unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly KILLER unit.
stratagems.tg: That KILLER unit.
stratagems.fx:
When a KILLER model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:

• On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
• On a 2+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.t: Host of Ascension – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

stratagems.t: Host of Ascension – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: Two GENESTEALER CULTS units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit (if this Stratagem is used in the Fight phase, that enemy unit must be within Engagement Range of both of your units). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.t: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Genestealer Cults Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.t: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One Genestealer Cults Battleline unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, when setting your unit up using a Cult Ambush marker, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that Cult Ambush marker and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.t: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.tg: One Genestealer Cults Infantry unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.fx: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.t: Host of Ascension – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.rs: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Genestealer Cults Mounted or Genestealer Cults Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting an enemy unit within 18".

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Goliath Rockgrinder or Goliath Truck unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: One Achilles Ridgerunners or Atalan Jackals unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.tg: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.fx: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Genestealer Cults Mounted or Genestealer Cults Vehicle unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.fx: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.tg: That PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.fx: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.tg: That PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has -6" detection range until the end of the turn.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models (excluding Characters) in your unit by 1 and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a Genestealer Cults Character model from your army.
stratagems.tg: One other GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the destroyed model was a Magus, Primus or Acolyte Iconward, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS or NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.fx:
• If your unit made an advance/fall-back move this turn, that **advance/fall-back move** does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
• When your unit declares a charge, you can use this part of this stratagem. If you do:

• Your unit can re-roll charge rolls.
• Your unit must end that charge move engaged with an enemy unit **engaged** with a friendly CHARACTER unit.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS or NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, you can set up your unit on the battlefield without using a Cult Ambush marker. When doing so, set up your unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.tg: One Acolyte Hybrids or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a move of up to D6", but it unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT), When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Acolyte Hybrids, Hybrid Metamorphs or Neophyte Hybrids unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit with every model within a terrain area.
stratagems.tg: That NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit.
stratagems.fx: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 **AP** until that unit has attacked

stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit within a terrain area.
stratagems.fx: Enemy units within that **terrain area** have +6" detection range

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.tg: That NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that enemy unit can re-roll hit rolls.

frules.d:
If your Army Faction is TYRANIDS, while a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly Synapse models, that TYRANIDS unit is said to be within Synapse Range of that model and of your army. While a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within Synapse Range of your army: 

• Each time that unit takes a Battle-shock test, take that test on 3D6 instead of 2D6. 
• Each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

If your Army Faction is TYRANIDS, once per battle, in either player’s Command phase, if one or more units from your army with this ability are on the battlefield, you can unleash the Shadow in the Warp. When you do, each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle-shock test. Each time an enemy unit takes such a Battle-shock test, if it is within 6" of one or more Synapse units from your army, subtract 1 from that test.

If your Army Faction is GENESTEALER CULTS, you start the battle with a number of Resurgence points, depending on the battle size, as shown below.

• **Incursion:** 6 Resurgence points
• **Strike Force:** 10 Resurgence points
• **Onslaught:** 14 Resurgence points
Each time a unit from your army is destroyed, if every model (excluding CHARACTER models) in that unit has this ability, you can spend the relevant number of Resurgence points shown below based on that unit’s Starting Strength (not including attached CHARACTER models).

**Aberrants**5 models4 Resurgence points10 models8 Resurgence points**Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers, Hybrid Metamorphs**5 models2 Resurgence points10 models4 Resurgence points**Atalan Jackals**5 models2 Resurgence points10 models6 Resurgence points**Neophyte Hybrids**10 models3 Resurgence points20 models6 Resurgence points**Purestrain Genestealers**5 models2 Resurgence points10 models6 Resurgence points
If you do:

• Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit (excluding CHARACTER models), in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
• Place one Cult Ambush marker (see below) anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed).
Units in Cult Ambush
Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker as described below, or by following the rules for Strategic Reserves in a subsequent turn. Units in Cult Ambush are not automically destroyed at the end of the third battle round.

Cult Ambush Markers
Use a circular 32mm diameter marker for Cult Ambush markers. If an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move within 8" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of your opponent’s next Movement phase, for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, you can select one unit from your army that is in Cult Ambush to make an ingress move. For that ingress move, set that unit up with at least one model in that unit in base contact with that Cult Ambush marker and all other models placed wholly within 3" of that Cult Ambush marker (that Cult Ambush marker is then removed from the battlefield). Units in Cult Ambush can make an ingress move in the first battle round using this rule.
